description: Fuaran op-stream linear-chain conformance corpus (WIRE_FORMAT.md 5.3.2, 5.3.5). SELF-ENUMERATED, so the directory is one corpus family (27.7): `chain`. chain-corpus.json carries the genesis previous-hash and one record per chained op — the op fixture it chains (a root-manifest ops/ payload), the 1-based sequence, actor, promptId, result and timestamp, and the stored previousHash and hash. A host decodes each op fixture, recomputes the format-version-2 pre-image hash from the record's provenance and its predecessor's hash, and asserts both stored hashes byte for byte. The records were generated by the reference HashChain.computeHash; the family is the UI tier's (its op payloads are UI TreeOp bytes, fuaran-core D191).
